segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to close the loop on the subscription order and make sure legal's redlines were good on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly good. Our counsel is fine with the 24-month term and the 60-day termination for non-appropriation. The only thing is operational: the kickoff invite we got from your services team shows a March 4 go-live. We had planned on February 20 because our March close starts the 24th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, yeah, February 20 is what I have here. Sorry about that. I'll have the project plan updated today and make sure the kickoff on Thursday is working toward that date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We can make Thursday at 11 Central. We’ll have payroll, IT, and two regional managers on it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. On seats, I have 76 active users for the initial order, with 8 more being added April 1 when the west region comes on. Annual contract value is $48,640, billed quarterly. Does that match your purchase request?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches the purchase request, yeah. The invoice that came in this morning was for 84 seats upfront though, and it was one annual amount. AP bounced it back to me.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, okay, thanks for flagging. That's not what you should have received. I'll get a corrected quarterly invoice out for 76 seats, and then the April add-on can be its own prorated line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you can send that by tomorrow morning, I can get it into the Friday check run. PO number is 41782, same as on the order form.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, PO 41782. I'll send the revised order packet, the corrected invoice, and the updated kickoff agenda all in one email by end of day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Once we have those, we can sign. Just no surprises for the February date, please.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I'll keep it tight and I'll confirm after the kickoff that the timeline still holds.
